purpose: Qualify every accepted 2016-2023 target and both oriented views for the agreed designated source site and the latest strictly earlier eligible same-season calendar interval from the accepted parents and the retained provider captures, freeze the complete-case common cohort, fit exactly CTX-HISTORY-LOGIT-V1 (h) and CTX-SITE-CALENDAR-LOGIT-V1 (h, s, c) on its 2016-2022 games with the unchanged accepted lambda-1 solver, score every target once per model, project the five unchanged C56 game-score comparators on the same cohort and serve six grains through the explicit --context-association mode; adverse and null results are completed results.

CTX-HISTORY-LOGIT-V1.formula: p_A = sigmoid(z . beta), z the FIT-RMS-scaled A-minus-B design (h), zero intercept
CTX-HISTORY-LOGIT-V1.objective: mean weighted binary cross-entropy over the paired FIT rows (weight 1/2 each) plus (1/2) sum(beta_j^2) (lambda 1, every column, zero intercept)

CTX-SITE-CALENDAR-LOGIT-V1.formula: p_A = sigmoid(z . beta), z the FIT-RMS-scaled A-minus-B design (h, s, c), zero intercept
CTX-SITE-CALENDAR-LOGIT-V1.objective: mean weighted binary cross-entropy over the paired FIT rows (weight 1/2 each) plus (1/2) sum(beta_j^2) (lambda 1, every column, zero intercept)

parent_comparators.release: the accepted C56 national retrospective reference (contract 3cfeff25..., identity ad01a42f...)
parent_comparators.witness: one record per accepted target and parent model holding the exact accepted C56 game-score record (parsed from its canonical line, which it must reproduce byte for byte), that line's SHA-256 and its metric kind; the 58,750 parent estimates stay in the accepted C56 release and are not duplicated
parent_comparators.unchanged: parent raw values, equations, parameters and their fitting population (5,087 games) never change; the projections are contextual benchmarks on the common cohort, not the two-model matched ablation
parent_comparators.ridge: PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_RIDGE_MARGIN_V1 is margin-only: absolute and squared margin errors, never a probability, Brier or log loss

binding.input: the accepted C38 participant identity bindings (identity_bindings.jsonl.gz of the pinned population)
binding.rule: each target participant org_id maps to exactly one binding row whose cfbd_team_id is a digit string and whose rule is NAME_CONFIRMED_BY_SCHEDULE or SCHEDULE_FINGERPRINT_ONLY; otherwise the side is UNSUPPORTED with its reason (NO_ACCEPTED_PARTICIPANT_BINDING, BINDING_DUPLICATED, BINDING_NOT_CONFIRMED); two participants bound to one provider team are PARTICIPANT_BINDING_UNSUPPORTED

provider_join.capture: the one pinned full FBS games capture of the target's own season
provider_join.documented_game_ids: the accepted C39 target's cfbd_game_ids, equal to its C38 parent contest row's; exactly one is required
provider_join.game_row: the single capture row whose integer id equals that identifier; a duplicated id is ambiguous
provider_join.field_shapes: id, season, homeId and awayId are JSON integers, neutralSite and startTimeTBD booleans and startDate a string; any other shape is PROVIDER_FIELD_MALFORMED
provider_join.season: the row's integer season equals the target's season
provider_join.participants: the unordered pair of the row's homeId and awayId equals the two bound cfbd_team_id values
provider_join.site_claim: neutralSite true claims NEUTRAL; false claims HOME for the side whose binding equals homeId (HOME_A or HOME_B); the claim is kept beside the accepted parent role, with explicit agreement
provider_join.never_read: points, line scores, Elo, win probabilities, attendance, venue or any other outcome or context field

date_window.rule: the provider start instant is compatible with the accepted calendar date D when it lies in [D 00:00 at UTC+14:00, D 24:00 at UTC-12:00), i.e. [D-1 10:00Z, D+1 12:00Z); no timezone is inferred for D (the accepted C58 window)
date_window.meaning: a scheduled provider claim compatible with the calendar date; never an actual kickoff

calendar.pool: the accepted C39 history view's contributing contests of the side (the accepted eligible same-season prior pool), equal to the accepted C56 feature's contributing contests
calendar.lineage: every eligible prior joins its own C38 parent contest of the same season, with that side as a participant, the recorded date and a date strictly before the target's; otherwise PRIOR_LINEAGE_INVALID
calendar.interval_days: target date minus the unique latest eligible prior date, in days (an exact integer)
calendar.intervening_calendar_days: interval_days minus one (reported, never a fitted column)
calendar.empty_pool: null with NO_ELIGIBLE_SAME_SEASON_PRIOR; never zero, never a previous season
calendar.tie: several eligible prior keys on the latest date: null with AMBIGUOUS_LATEST_PRIOR and every key; never input order
calendar.excluded: excluded (ineligible) earlier same-season inputs are counted; those dated after the latest eligible prior are counted separately (the interval is to the latest eligible prior, not to every game played)

site.agreement: AGREE when the provider claim equals the accepted parent site (HOME_A, HOME_B or NEUTRAL); DISAGREE otherwise; UNSUPPORTED when the provider game is not joined or the parent site is not one of the three
site.code: s = +1 for agreed HOME of the view's team, -1 for agreed HOME of its opponent, 0 for agreed NEUTRAL; null unless AGREE
site.neutral_swap: a nominal home/away designation swap at an agreed NEUTRAL site keeps s = 0 and only reorients the team-bound values

support.rule: COMMON_SUPPORT when both bindings are BOUND, the provider game is joined, the agreed site is AGREE, the start claim is COMPATIBLE_WITH_PARENT_LOCAL_DATE and both sides have QUALIFIED_CALENDAR_INTERVAL; otherwise OUTSIDE_COMMON_SUPPORT with every failing reason in a fixed order
reason_order: PROVIDER_<join reason> (a reason already starting PROVIDER_ is kept; PARTICIPANT_BINDING_UNSUPPORTED only when both bindings are BOUND)
support.frozen: the common cohort is the committed contract's expected collection (observed by the full source-only census before any fit); a derivation that differs is refused as population drift, never forced
support.labels: label identity is exact (the accepted C56 label of the same game); only DECISIVE labels enter the fit and the probability scores

design.history_log_odds: ell_s = math.log(2*wins_s + ties_s + 2) - math.log(2*losses_s + ties_s + 2) with the integer arguments formed exactly and the two binary64 logarithms of the pinned CPython subtracted once
design.history_counts: the accepted C56 feature record's same-season, strictly earlier-date wins, losses, ties and games of each side, the target excluded, with the contributing contest keys kept as lineage
design.s: the agreed designated site code of view A as a binary64 (+1.0, -1.0 or 0.0)
design.c: interval_days_A - interval_days_B as an exact integer, converted once to binary64; no clipping or binning
design.orientation: view A is the canonical (parent a) side; view B's vector is the exact negation of view A's (negative zero normalized to zero), never recomputed
design.missing: outside common support the design is null, never zero; every model abstains

scaling.rule: scale_j = math.sqrt(math.fsum(0.5 * x_ij * x_ij for every paired FIT row i, A then B, in canonical game order) / N_fit_games); no centering (odd orientation symmetry preserved); a zero scale is 1 and the column is marked constant; z_ij = x_ij / scale_j
scaling.rows: the FIT cohort only (common-support 2016-2022 games with a DECISIVE label); never a 2023 game
scaling.shared: both models use the same history-column scale (the first scale of the three-column design)

fit.cohort: common-support games of 2016-2022 whose accepted label is DECISIVE, canonical (season, date, contest key) order
fit.rows: per game the A row (z, y_A) and the B row (-z, 1 - y_A), each of weight 1/2 (total weight = games)
fit.failure: a refused fit (FIT_EMPTY, FIT_RAGGED, FIT_NONFINITE_INPUT, FIT_NONFINITE, FIT_NOT_CONVERGED, FIT_SINGULAR, FIT_BACKTRACK_EXHAUSTED) is recorded with its trajectory as the parameter state; that model then abstains on every game (ABSTAIN_FIT_FAILED); nothing is tuned afterwards
fit.comparison_2023: never in the fit, the scales, early stopping, any constant or any selection
fit.no_search: no penalty, column, transformation or cohort search; no change after any outcome

estimates.game_grain: the A-orientation probability is built first; B is its exact decimal complement
estimates.fitted: p_A = decimal12(rf.sigmoid(rf.linear(z_A, beta))); p_B = 1 - p_A exactly in decimal; the linear predictor decimal12 and both unrounded values as repr() text are kept
estimates.support: only common-support games are estimated; every other game abstains for both new models with ABSTAIN_OUTSIDE_COMMON_SUPPORT and the support reasons

scores.orientation: A (the canonical game); each canonical game is counted once per model
scores.brier: (p_A served - y_A)^2 as an exact rational of the served decimal probability
scores.log_loss: -math.log(clip(q)) with q the correctly rounded binary64 of the exact served probability of the observed side, clip to [1e-15, 1 - 1e-15] applied only to the argument (CLIPPED_LOG_ARGUMENT_1E-15); repr() text

unscored.LABEL_TIE: a tie is never made decisive

scores.grain: the context-score grain serves the 11,750 new score records and the 29,375 unchanged parent witnesses together in (season, date, contest key, model) order, each with its score_source and metric_kind

summary.windows: SEASON 2016..2023, PARTITION FIT (2016-2022) and PARTITION COMPARISON (2023); the season 2023 and pooled COMPARISON windows are distinct scopes; no pooled in-sample plus comparison window
summary.rows: one row per window and model, 70 canonical rows, in window then model order
summary.cohort: every row of a window uses exactly the common-support games of that window (and of the selection); window targets, eligible games, excluded games and, for parents, their original scored games are separate counts
summary.probability_metrics: scored and unscored games by reason, Brier total and mean (exact rationals with decimal12), log loss total (math.fsum in canonical game order) and mean (repr)
summary.margin_metrics: PAIRED_ZERO_INTERCEPT_RIDGE_MARGIN_V1: absolute and squared margin error totals, MAE and MSE (exact rationals with decimal12) and RMSE = math.sqrt of the binary64 of the exact MSE; never a probability metric
summary.fit_partition: FIT-window rows of the new models are fitted-data (in-sample) summaries; COMPARISON rows are exposed, out-of-fit and not blind
summary.challenger_delta: only the CTX-SITE-CALENDAR-LOGIT-V1 row carries challenger-minus-CTX-HISTORY-LOGIT-V1 Brier and log-loss mean differences on the identical scored games of the same window and selection; the control is computed even when --model hides its row; every other row's delta is null and NOT_CLAIMED; a failed fit leaves null differences with the failure reason
summary.primary: the challenger row of the unfiltered PARTITION COMPARISON window: challenger minus control Brier mean over the common 2023 games (negative = lower descriptive Brier, zero = equal, positive = higher)
summary.common_scored_keys: all probability models without a recorded fit failure score exactly the same game keys in a window; the margin model scores the decisive and tied eligible games
summary.selection: with any season/partition/team/contest selector the rows are re-derived over exactly the selected eligible games before any model filter or paging; a window without a selected eligible game has no row; an empty eligible selection returns rows = []; --model keeps that model's rows and never changes the cohort or the hidden control
summary.no_inference: no significance, bootstrap, calibration, champion, causal or predictive-skill conclusion

numeric.arithmetic: IEEE-754 binary64 in a fixed order; every reduction math.fsum; math.log, math.exp, math.log1p and math.sqrt of the pinned CPython 3.12.10
numeric.decimal12: a served binary64 value is its exact decimal expansion rounded half-even to 12 places (negative zero normalized) as a JSON string; complements and negations are exact decimal operations
numeric.rationals: {numerator, denominator} JSON integers in lowest terms, denominator > 0
numeric.floats: binary64 log-odds and design values are JSON numbers (finite; their repr round-trips exactly; negative zero normalized to zero)
numeric.counts: JSON integers only, within their domain; a boolean or an integral float is not a count
numeric.independent_tolerance: an independent oracle agrees within 1e-9 absolute on scales, coefficients and probabilities and within 1e-8 on objective and gradients; keys, counts, states, identities and exact rationals agree exactly; byte identity of rebuilds is a separate property
numeric.canonical_json: json.dumps(value, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False) as UTF-8

grains.qualifications: one record per accepted 2016-2023 target (<contest_key>), all 5,875
grains.features: one record per target view (<contest_key>|<view>), all 11,750
grains.estimates: one record per target, new model and orientation (<contest_key>|<model>|<orientation>)
grains.scores: one A-oriented new score per target and new model (<contest_key>|<model>)
grains.witnesses: one unchanged C56 parent game-score witness per target and parent model (<contest_key>|<model>)
grains.summary: one row per window and model (<scope_kind>:<scope_id>|<model>), 70

ordering.features: season, contest_date, contest_key, view (A then B)
ordering.estimates: season, contest_date, contest_key, model (the two new models), orientation (A then B)
ordering.scores: season, contest_date, contest_key, model (the two new models)
ordering.witnesses: season, contest_date, contest_key, model (the five parent models in registry order)
ordering.summary: window (SEASON 2016..2023, PARTITION FIT, PARTITION COMPARISON), model (registry order)

layout.serialization: canonical JSON lines (sorted keys, separators ',' ':', UTF-8, no ASCII escaping); one zlib level-9 block per seasonal table and season, one GLOBAL block each for parameters, summary and census

ddl: CREATE TABLE meta (key TEXT NOT NULL, value TEXT NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE blocks (ord INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, record_table TEXT NOT NULL, segment TEXT NOT NULL, records INTEGER NOT NULL, first_key TEXT, last_key TEXT, lines_sha256 TEXT NOT NULL, block BLOB NOT NULL)

identity_documents.identity: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON bytes of the document; compared as canonical bytes, never by Python equality (an integral float, a boolean or an extra member differs)
identity_documents.location: <root>/canonical/national_site_calendar_association_2016_2023/sha256/<database identity>/national_site_calendar_association.sqlite; manifest at <root>/manifests/national_site_calendar_association_2016_2023/sha256/<database identity>/run_manifest.json with members identity, identity_document, content_identity, content_document and provenance; create-only (identical rebuild ALREADY_PRESENT_IDENTICAL, differing bytes REFUSED_IMMUTABLE_COLLISION)

layout.checkpoint_unit: a run of consecutive canonical targets (--chunk-size targets): their qualification, feature, estimate, score and witness lines; parameters, summary and census follow

selectors.season: four ASCII digits; the study seasons are 2016-2023 (a well-formed other season selects no game and serves no row with SEASON_OUTSIDE_RELEASE)
selectors.partition: FIT (2016-2022) or COMPARISON (2023); with --season a compatible pair restricts to that season and an incompatible pair selects no game
selectors.team: org:<1-12 digits> or bare digits (the accepted team key), or an exact team name the record's own season carries for that team (never borrowed across seasons); a well-formed unknown team selects no game
selectors.contest: an accepted contest key ncaa:<digits> (bare digits read as ncaa:<digits>); a well-formed unknown contest selects no game
selectors.model: one of the seven registered model IDs (closed namespace); applicability per grain follows the matrix
selectors.paging: --limit (default 50, non-negative integer) and --offset (default 0, non-negative integer), or --all; --all with an explicit --limit or --offset is PAGING_CONFLICT; exact totals in record order; filters and summary re-derivation precede paging
selectors.intersection: every applicable supplied selector applies and they intersect over canonical games; an unknown or disjoint valid selection serves no row, summaries included (rows = [], never a fabricated zero-count summary)
selectors.explicit_empty: an explicitly supplied empty value is never treated as absent: an empty model is MODEL_INVALID, an empty season, partition, team or contest INVALID_SELECTOR, an empty limit or offset LIMIT_INVALID or OFFSET_INVALID, an empty manifest a location refusal
selectors.pit: --require-pit is always refused; --cutoff and --as-of are TEMPORAL_FLAG_UNSUPPORTED; no historical as-of selector exists

precedence: 1 argument syntax (unknown option, missing value, missing --grain): ARGUMENT_INVALID
6 paging: LIMIT_INVALID, OFFSET_INVALID, NEGATIVE_LIMIT, NEGATIVE_OFFSET, PAGING_CONFLICT
8 game selector values in the order season, partition, team, contest: INVALID_SELECTOR
9 applicability in the order season, partition, team, contest, model: SELECTOR_NOT_APPLICABLE
10 --expect-identity: STALE_CONTEXT_IDENTITY when not a SHA-256 identity
11 then (and only then) the database and manifest location policy and the complete release verification

refusals.stderr: one JSON object with members refused (the code) and error (the text); nothing on stdout

scope.population: all 5,875 accepted C39/C56 2016-2023 targets (11,750 oriented views); the common cohort is the frozen complete-case support of the source qualification
scope.fit_and_comparison: FIT 2016-2022 (fitted-data summaries), COMPARISON 2023 (already exposed, not blind)
scope.parent_reads: read-only whole-file hashing of the accepted parents includes their 2024/2025 bytes; no 2024/2025 target, feature, label, design, fit, score or evaluation is selected or derived
scope.not_in_scope: 2024/2025 protected seasons, prospective or production training, forecasts, PIT admission, calibration, actual venues, travel, rest, weather, personnel, markets, film and A&M specialization

consumer.default: never a default; explicit selection only
